text: Small steps still move you forward.
A short pause is not lost time.
You can begin again, as many times as you need.
Progress is quiet more often than it is loud.
Being here, now, is enough.
Gentle and steady is still moving.
One calm breath is a good place to start.
You are allowed to do this slowly.
What matters is that you came back to it.
